result.topic_en: An archival cover sheet (in a later hand, not Gauss's) noting that sheets 1–3 of the optics folder were taken from Hindenburg's Archiv der reinen und angewandten Mathematik, vol. I, p. 258 ff., which contains Count von Brühl's treatise on examining astronomical circles by Ramsden of London.
